create_locobotbase_init: create a LoCoBotBase instance with configs and simulator to initialize robot state in Habitat-Sim
execute_action_turn_move: execute a turn_left, turn_right, or move_forward action on the robot and check for collisions
get_state_odom: get the robot current odometry state as x, y, yaw tuple relative to initial pose
go_to_relative_pose: move the robot to a relative x, y, yaw goal position from its initial pose
go_to_absolute_pose: move the robot to an absolute x, y, yaw goal position in the world frame
